President Trump (00:00):

... be back in the great state of Texas, which we won over and over again.

Audience (00:06):

USA, USA, USA!

President Trump (00:12):

Ah, thank you very much. The gleaming shores of the Gulf of America. See, that's one of the things we did. We did so much, that's like one of the ... I don't want to call it a throw-in because it's very important, but it's like a little throw-in. And I said, we ought to just sort of change the name. We have 92% of the frontage. But they were there first, they've been here 100 years longer. Gulf of Mexico, 100 years longer. Now it's the Gulf of America because we have 92%. I wouldn't say Mexico was thrilled, but they were fine.

(00:47)
And I'm delighted to be here at this national treasure, one of the largest energy export hubs anywhere in the world, anywhere in the world. The Port of Corpus Christi, we had a lot to do with it. That bridge, we had so much. What a nice bridge. Ooh, I like that color. What a nice bridge. And we dredged nation deeply. I guess they said 54 feet or something. It's about as deep as you can go. I think we could go a few feet deeper and then you could ...

Audience (01:17):

55!

President Trump (01:18):

You want to go a little bit deeper? What the hell? What the hell? It's only money.

(01:24)
With the men and women here today, we're unleashing America's potential, strengthening our security, increasing our prosperity. We had the most successful country anywhere in the world. A year and a half ago, we had a dead country. Our country was dead, you know it better than anybody. And cementing America's status as the number one energy superpower by far, anywhere on earth.

(01:48)
And I want to thank Venezuela because our relationship is a very good one. A very, very good one. We're having a very good relationship. That boat, that ship is from Venezuela.

(02:01)
For four long years before I took office, the Biden administration, sleepy Joe Biden, one of the worst presidents in history. Not one of the ... I have to think, the worst. Can you get worse?

Audience (02:15):

No!

President Trump (02:15):

Somebody said, "Please don't be political today." Okay. But he's the worst president we've ever had. And its allies in Congress waged a radical left war in American oil and natural gas like you've never seen before. They were killing our country and killing your area right here. In fact, they say if I wanted, I could work ... If I ran for the Mayor of Corpus Christi, would I win? I think so. What the hell? I looked at your job stats. You have done very well with Trump.

Audience (02:46):

Run!

President Trump (02:46):

They killed the Keystone XL Pipeline. This is the Biden group. Here's the good news. In all fairness, he had no idea what the hell was happening, but it was his administration of horrible people. Horrible, radical left people. No, he used the autopen very well. There's never been anybody in history that used an autopen like that. Almost conclusively. He piled crippling regulations on producers and refiners, opposed natural gas export ban, and slashed new leases for drilling by 95%. That's Biden. Under their Green New scam, one of the greatest scams in history, gasoline reached a peak of over $ 6 a gallon in some states fueling the worst inflation in the history of our country. We had the worst inflation in the history of our country.

Audience (03:38):

Boo!

President Trump (03:39):

You've heard me say this before, the fake news, sitting back there. They say, "Trump exaggerated. It wasn't in history." They say it was 48 years. Okay, we'll take that too. In a way, 48 years sounds even worse, if you want to know the truth. But they tell me it's 48 years. It's not, I think it's the history of our country. But whether it's 48 years or the history of our country, they're both pretty bad. Do we agree? But all of that changed. My first day back in office, it all changed. Our country started coming back like never before.

Audience (04:16):

Yeah!

President Trump (04:16):

On day one, I declared a national energy emergency. I ended the Biden export ban and I told our great Texas energy workers to, very simply, drill, baby, drill.

Audience (04:28):

Drill, baby, drill.

President Trump (04:35):

Since my inauguration, US oil production is now up by 600,000 barrels a day. Natural gas production is at an all time record high, by far. And today, right here in Corpus Christi, the price of gasoline is down to just, less than actually now, $2.30. I just left Iowa two weeks ago, $1.99. And then I passed another one, $1.85. It's happening. It's happening.

(05:10)
So we're witnessing a historic American energy boom like we've never seen, and this port is right at the center of the action. So, who lives here, or this area? Who lives?

Audience (05:27):

Yeah!

President Trump (05:27):

Not bad. A lot of happy people here. It's nice to be loved. It's nice to be loved.

Audience (05:32):

We love you, Pres.

President Trump (05:33):

Thank you.

Audience (05:33):

Yeah.

Thank you. In my first term, I approved vital federal funding to deepen the channel and fully modernize the ... Christi. Since that crucial investment, companies have flocked here, creating tens of thousands of jobs and generating billions and billions of dollars in revenue for your community.

(05:59)
Joe Biden came in and tried to cut off the port funding, immediately tried to cut it off what we did. We had a tremendously successful first term, and he came in and tried to take away what we had. We stopped them. And today, the dock workers, energy workers, and great people of Texas, once again, really have a president that loves our country. A president that fights for our country. And a president who's got your back.

Yeah!

Nationwide exports of liquefied natural gas are up 37%. Think of that. And the past year, the highest level in American history and going up a lot. Crude oil exports are up by hundreds of thousands of barrels a day. Venezuela, think of it, 80 million. So far, we just started, 80 million barrels of fuel. Think 80 million barrels of oil. Think of what that means. Think of a stadium with 80,000 people. Now say 80 million. That's what we've taken.

(07:11)
And it's great for Venezuela, it is great for us. It's great for us, great for Venezuela. And a lot of it, like that, a lot of it comes right here. And with our new friend and partner, Venezuela, we're going to do a lot of other things. We're going to be doing a lot. We're having a great relationship with their government. Has anybody ever witnessed anything so beautiful, so decisive, and so popular with the people of Venezuela? It was very popular. In fact, 360,000 barrels of Venezuelan crude are right now sitting in the tanker on my left.

Wow!

We're going to give some to them and they're going to make more money than they've ever made before. We'll help build their country again, which was a disaster. And we're going to build it up and we're going to benefit also. And that's the way it's supposed to be, right? It's going to be great.

That includes no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and no tax on Social Security for our great seniors.

We also got you an interest deduction if you buy a car. If you borrow some money to buy a car, you have a loan, you're allowed to deduct the interest for income tax purposes. Never happened before, but only if it's an American made car. We put that in. We've cut a record number of job-killing regulations, slashing 129 old regulations for every one new regulation that we approve. So, if we put a regulation on, we slash 129 old regulations, which is far and above what anybody's been able to do. We terminated the insane electric vehicle mandate where you had to have a car, all electric car, within a couple of years. It was not going to work.

(16:52)

These people are crazy. But the mandate is over and the other radical attacks. And now you can go out and you can buy a gasoline-powered car, a hybrid, an electric car. They said, "There's no way that could be done." I did them both by the end of my first year, not my fourth year, my first, which means you also did them both, so everybody's happy. Nobody ever thought that's possible. And we passed the bill, the Great Big Beautiful Bill that the Democrats always said, "Oh, the Great Big Bill." They don't know. It's basically the great, big, beautiful tax cut bill if you really want to look at it, probably more accurate name. Every parent can actively just activate all of their children's accounts. We have a new thing, and it was Michael and Susan Dell, Dell computer. Go out and buy a Dell computer. They're great because he put up 6 billion, 250 million in the Trump Accounts, and it's for children. It's tax-free investment accounts for every American child, every single American child born rich. So, millions and millions will be pre-funded courtesy of the US Treasury. And private individuals like Michael and Susan Dell who have donated the... Think of it, 6 billion. He put up 6 billion, 250 million, and now he wants to put up more to fund what's called the Trump Accounts for 25 million American children.

(22:08)

They started with nothing and a small amount of seed money, and by the time they're 18 years old, they could have well over $100,000. And to make this investment in our children's future, go to trumpacounts.gov. It is amazing. It's going through the roof.
